system.description:
2 Armour Slots. Airtight: you can breathe and act normally where the air is unbreathable (space, underwater), but once the suit is at 0 Health Points the environment affects you. Warm: you are Resistant to Cold damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.154

automation.note: Airtight: you breathe and act normally in unbreathable environments such as space or underwater. When this armour reaches 0 HP the environment's effects apply to you.
